source_backbone: Kew POWO/WCVP 2026; IPNI; primary cytogenetic review and USFS FEIS historical taxonomic synthesis
historical_spelling_alias: Andropogon gerardii (widely used spelling; IPNI explicitly retains original gerardi)
synonym_and_rank_caution: POWO species-level page lists 2 homotypic synonyms; accepted var. gerardi separately lists 14 heterotypic synonyms. Cross-species mappings to A. hallii must not be lost.
related_accepted_species: Andropogon hallii Hack. (distinct POWO accepted species; no learner installation implied)
native_range_audit: DEFERRED — NOT REVIEWED; existing canonical native claims unchanged
photo_and_specimen_identity: HOLD — accepted name does not verify any individual image/specimen
hybrid_provenance: HOLD — no individual plant hybrid or introgression determination
install_decision: Existing canonical big bluestem only; no installation or duplicate synonym/variety species card

decisions.subject: Andropogon gerardi Vitman
decisions.proposed_decision: Retain accepted Poaceae species and existing canonical binomial/authority
decisions.detail: Original publication Summa Pl. 6:16 (1792); POWO/WCVP accepted.

decisions.subject: gerardi versus gerardii orthography
decisions.proposed_decision: Retain gerardi as original accepted epithet; preserve gerardii as searchable spelling, not a separately accepted taxon
decisions.detail: IPNI explicitly explains why original gerardi is retained instead of correction to gerardii; US references often use gerardii.

decisions.subject: Anatherum gerardi (Vitman) D.L.Fu
decisions.proposed_decision: Record 2024 homotypic genus combination as synonym of A. gerardi
decisions.detail: Newly published genus combination is not the POWO accepted name.

decisions.subject: Sorghum provinciale Kuntze
decisions.proposed_decision: Record homotypic synonym, illegitimate superfluous name, not separate species
decisions.detail: POWO marks nom. illeg. superfl.

decisions.subject: Andropogon gerardi var. gerardi
decisions.proposed_decision: Recognize accepted autonym variety under A. gerardi
decisions.detail: Do not treat rank as a second species.

decisions.subject: Andropogon gerardi var. hondurensis R.W.Pohl
decisions.proposed_decision: Recognize separately accepted infraspecific variety, not synonym of var. gerardi
decisions.detail: POWO accepted variety; originally published 1992.

decisions.subject: Andropogon furcatus Muhl. ex Willd.
decisions.proposed_decision: Map heterotypic historical name to A. gerardi var. gerardi under POWO
decisions.detail: POWO lists this name among 14 synonyms of the accepted autonym variety.

decisions.subject: Andropogon chrysocomus Nash
decisions.proposed_decision: Map historical heterotypic name to A. gerardi var. gerardi under POWO
decisions.detail: Historical source determination requires independent specimen verification.

decisions.subject: Andropogon hallii Hack.
decisions.proposed_decision: Maintain as distinct accepted Poaceae species under POWO/WCVP
decisions.detail: Do not silently collapse sand bluestem into big bluestem.

decisions.subject: Andropogon gerardi subsp. hallii (Hack.) Wipff
decisions.proposed_decision: Map homotypic historical subspecies combination to separately accepted A. hallii
decisions.detail: Historical infraspecific parent binomial does not determine accepted species.

decisions.subject: Andropogon gerardi var. paucipilus (Nash) Fernald
decisions.proposed_decision: Map heterotypic historical variety to A. hallii, not A. gerardi
decisions.detail: Important cross-species historical rank mapping.

decisions.subject: Andropogon gerardi var. incanescens (Hack.) B.Boivin
decisions.proposed_decision: Map heterotypic historical variety to A. hallii
decisions.detail: POWO includes it in A. hallii synonymy.

decisions.subject: Andropogon hallii var. grandiflorus Scribn.
decisions.proposed_decision: Map historical variety to A. gerardi var. gerardi, despite hallii parent binomial
decisions.detail: Reverse-direction cross-species mapping: never infer accepted identity from historical first two words.

decisions.subject: Automatically merge A. hallii into A. gerardi
decisions.proposed_decision: Reject merger under project's current POWO/WCVP backbone
decisions.detail: Alternative historical circumscription and hybridization are documented, but both species currently accepted.

decisions.subject: Automatically map all A. gerardi historical varieties/subspecies to A. gerardi
decisions.proposed_decision: Reject; hallii, paucipilus, incanescens resolve to A. hallii
decisions.detail: Preserve original author and rank for each historical determination.

decisions.subject: Automatically rename canonical big bluestem to Anatherum gerardi or Andropogon gerardii
decisions.proposed_decision: Reject changing accepted name on publication or popularity alone
decisions.detail: Anatherum is homotypic but unaccepted; gerardii is widespread alternative spelling, not Kew's accepted orthography.

decisions.subject: Identification of individual big bluestem gallery photographs and historical specimens
decisions.proposed_decision: No new specimen ID conclusions from nomenclatural verification
decisions.detail: Photo/source observation must be checked independently where diagnostic identity is uncertain.

decisions.subject: Hybrid ancestry, introgression or cultivar identity of individual A. gerardi / A. hallii specimens
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve hybrid/identity holds; do not infer ancestry from published hybrid zones
decisions.detail: Interfertility and natural hybrid zones do not establish ancestry for an untested individual.

decisions.subject: Historical A. hallii versus A. gerardi species/subspecies circumscriptions
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve competing treatments and hybrid-zone evidence; POWO accepted species boundary controls current name mapping
decisions.detail: Historical taxonomies lumped the two at infraspecific rank; molecular/cytogenetic and ecological literature discusses hybrid swarms. No individual determination settled.

decisions.subject: 2024 Anatherum gerardi genus circumscription versus POWO accepted Andropogon
decisions.proposed_decision: Record alternative published combination without changing backbone
decisions.detail: A published new combination does not by itself resolve competing genus circumscriptions; no separate phylogenetic adjudication in this run.

sources.authority: USDA Forest Service FEIS sand bluestem 1988
